patthana23.33:1.1: na micchattaniyataṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā sammattaniyato kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā cha.
patthana23.33:2.1: na micchattaniyataṃ na akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā micchattaniyato akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā cha.
patthana23.33:3.1: na micchattaniyataṃ na abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca aniyato abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā cha. namaggārammaṇattika kusalattike maggārammaṇattika kusalattikaṃ
